children: AWARDED CONTRACT BY REN-GAS FOR ENGINEERING, PROCUREMENT AND FABRICATION FOR CARBON CAPTURE UNIT FOR TAMPERE POWER-TO-GAS PROJECT IN FINLAND
UNDER CONTRACT, SAIPEM WILL DELIVER FIRST FULL SCALE CARBON CAPTURE UNIT BASED ON ITS PROPRIETARY CO2 SOLUTIONS TECHNOLOGY AND INDUSTRIALIZED BLUENZYME 200 SOLUTION
CONTRACT WILL BECOME EFFECTIVE UPON REN-GAS FINAL INVESTMENT DECISION FOR TAMPERE E-METHANE PROJECT.
